methods.name: 2SLS / IV: coefficients, classical and HC1 SEs, first-stage (weak-instrument) F, Sargan; first-stage diagnostics; missing values
methods.reference: AER::ivreg; AER::summary.ivreg(diagnostics = TRUE) (ivdiag: weak-instrument F = partial F of the excluded instruments); vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(type = 'HC1'); anova(lm(x ~ controls), lm(x ~ controls + instruments))
quantities: first-stage regression R2, adj. R2, instrument coefficients and SEs
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 294-500: coefficients 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6 relative, p-values 1e-6 relative or 1e-12 absolute; counts and df exact
